bull.narrative: Almonty Industries successfully expands its tungsten supply chain, leading to significant revenue growth and increased market capitalization.

base.narrative: Almonty Industries maintains its current position in the tungsten supply chain, with moderate revenue growth and stable market capitalization.

tracking_note: Monitoring revenue growth and supply chain developments.
